# awscc_appsync_api_key (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::AppSync::ApiKey



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_id` (String) Unique AWS AppSync GraphQL API ID for this API key.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Unique description of your API key.
- `expires` (Number) The time after which the API key expires. The date is represented as seconds since the epoch, rounded down to the nearest hour.

### Read-Only

- `api_key` (String) The API key.
- `api_key_id` (String) The API key ID.
- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the API key.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_appsync_api_key.example
  identity = {
    api_id     = "api_id"
    api_key_id = "api_key_id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `api_id` (String) Unique AWS AppSync GraphQL API ID for this API key
- `api_key_id` (String) The API key ID

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_appsync_api_key.example
  id = "api_id|api_key_id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_appsync_api_key.example "api_id|api_key_id"
```
